cluster_stories.title: South Korea Exploring Using Hyundai Robots as Army Numbers Fall
cluster_stories.summary: South Korea’s military is exploring a strategic partnership with Hyundai Motor Co. to potentially deploy robotics to the front lines as Seoul accelerates investment in AI-powered, unmanned systems to tackle a deepening troop shortage.
cluster_stories.headline: SOUTH KOREA MILITARY EXPLORES HYUNDAI COMBAT ROBOTS as Troops Decline

cluster_stories.title: AI Dividend Proposal Roils Korean Market | Bloomberg Tech 5/12/2026
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Caroline Hyde and Ed Ludlow discuss comments by a South Korean policymaker that the country should pay citizens a “dividend” using taxes on AI profits. Plus, the largest US derivatives exchange, CME, is planning to create a futures market for computing power, one of the key drivers of the AI boom. And, the CEO of SAP talks about the company’s push into AI agents across business operations. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: KOREA PROPOSES AI DIVIDEND FOR CITIZENS

cluster_stories.title: South Korea official floats AI profit social tax as tech giants boom
cluster_stories.summary: A top South Korean official has proposed a tax on AI profits to be redistributed among society as a semiconductor boom drives massive earnings for tech giants Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. Kim proposed what he tentatively called a "national dividend" for socially redistributing excess corporate profits from AI technology.
cluster_stories.headline: SOUTH KOREA FLOATS AI PROFIT TAX... Samsung Boom Triggers Redistribution

cluster_stories.title: South Korea Floats ‘Citizen Dividend’ Using AI Profits
cluster_stories.summary: South Korea should pay all citizens a share of AI profits, a top policymaker has urged, as a labor dispute threatens to disrupt production at Samsung Electronics Co.’s chip division.
cluster_stories.headline: SOUTH KOREA PROPOSES AI PROFIT SHARING... CITIZEN DIVIDEND
